senses.gloss:
कुबधू कु-बधू, ऊस्, f. (see 1. कु), a wicked
wife.

कुबन्ध कु-बन्ध, अस्, m. (see 1. कु), a dis-
graceful stigma; [cf. अङ्क-बन्ध.]

कुबल कुबल, कुबल-प्रस्थ, कुबलाश्व,
&c. See under कुवल, &c.

कुबुद्धि कु-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ (see 1. कु), a
person of base or vile sentiments; stupid, foolish.

कुबेर कुबेर, or in later Sanskrit कुवेर, अस्,
m. (said to be fr. rt. कुम्ब् or fr. 1. कु and वेर),
originally N. of the chief of the evil beings or spirits
of darkness with the epithet Vaiśravaṇa; afterwards
the god of riches and treasure, the regent of the
northern quarter of the world, which is hence called
Kubera-guptā dik; (कुबेर is the son of Viśravas by
Iḍaviḍā, the chief of the Yakṣas, and a friend of
Rudra; he is represented as having three legs and
only eight teeth); with Jainas, the attendant of the
nineteenth Arhat of the present Avasarpiṇī; N. of a
prince of Deva-rāṣṭra; or N. of the great-grand-
father of Vāṇa-bhaṭṭa, the author of the Kādambarī;
or of the author of the Dattaka-candrikā; the tree
Cedrela Toona; (अस्, आ, अम्), deformed, monstrous;
slow, lazy; [cf. कुवेर.]
—कुबेर-नलिनी, f., N. of
a Tīrtha.
—कुबेर-बान्धव, अस्, m. an epithet of
Śiva, ‘the relation of Kubera.’
—कुबेर-वन, अम्,
n. ‘the forest of Kubera,’ N. of a place.
—कुबेर-
वल्लभ, अस्, m., N. of a Vaiśya.
—कुबेराक्षी
(˚र-अक्˚), f. the plant Bignonia Suaveolens.
—कु-
बेराचल (˚र-अच्˚), अस्, m. ‘the mountain of Kubera,’
an epithet of the Kailāsa mountain.
—कुबेराद्रि
(˚र-अद्˚), इस्, m. an epithet of the Kailāsa mountain.

कुबेरक, अस्, m. the tree Cedrela Toona (तुन्न);
(इका), f., N. of a woman.

कुबेरिण कुबेरिण, अस्, m. (?), N. of a mixed
caste.

कुब्ज कुब्ज, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. 1. कु and rt. उब्ज्?),
hump-backed, crooked; (अस्), m. a curved sword, scy-
mitar; a sort of fish, Bola Cuja; the plant Achyran-
thes Aspera, = अपामार्ग; [cf. न्युब्ज and कन्य-
कुब्ज; cf. also Lith. kupra, kupotas; Gr. κυφός,
κύπτω Lat. gibbus, gibba, gibber; Germ. Höcker?].
—कुब्ज-कण्टक, अस्, m. a white Mimosa.
—कुब्-
ज-किरात or कुब्ज-वामन, अम्, n. a hump-backed
person and a dwarf.
—कुब्जाम्रक (˚ज-आम्˚), अस्
or अम् (?), m. or n. (?), N. of a Tīrtha.
—कुब्जा-
लीढ (˚ज-आल्˚), अस्, m., N. of the founder of a sect.

कुब्जक, अस्, आ, अम्, hump-backed, crooked; (अस्),
m. the aquatic plant Trapa Bispinosa; (इका), f. in
the word कुब्जिका-तन्त्र, N. of a Tantra; according
to some authorities कुब्जिका कुमारी is a girl eight
years old personating the goddess Durgā at a festival
of this deity.
कुब्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, crooked, curved, bent.

कुब्र कुब्र, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. कुम्ब्),
a forest; a hole for sacrificial fire; a ring, an ear-
ring; a thread; a cart.

कुब्रह्म कु-ब्रह्म, अस्, m. or कु-ब्रह्मन्,
आ, m. (see 1. कु), a degraded or contemptible Brāh-
man, one who officiates for Śūdras.

कूबर कूबर, or in the later language
generally कूवर, अस्, ई, अम्, m. f. n. the pole of a
carriage or the wooden frame to which the yoke is
fixed; (ई), f. a carriage covered with a cloth or blanket;
(अस्), m. a hump-backed man; (अस्, ई, अम्), beautiful,
agreeable, pleasing.
कूबरिन् or कूवरिन्, ई, m. a carriage.
